#| label: setup

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(lme4)
library(broom.mixed)
library(emmeans)
library(knitr)

options(scipen = 999)

## 1. Import the data

#| label: import-data

file_path <- paste0(
  "D:/PhD in Political Science-UTD/",
  "Fall 2026/",
  "Methods of Data Collection and Production/",
  "avinash13808138.github.io/",
  "GTD-India_Avinash_with_Districts_and_OCI_",
  "MatchedData_with_Controls_Final 2(2).xlsx"
)

if (!file.exists(file_path)) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "The Excel file was not found at:\n",
      file_path,
      "\n\nCurrent working directory:\n",
      getwd()
    )
  )
}

data_raw <- read_excel(
  path = file_path,
  sheet = "Sheet1"
)

cat(
  "Rows in original data:",
  nrow(data_raw),
  "\n"
)


## 2. Construct a common analytical sample


#| label: analytical-sample

required_variables <- c(
  "Target Category",
  "gname",
  "iyear",
  "ideology_category",
  "conflict_region",
  "OCI_eligible",
  "z_prior_attacks",
  "z_tactical_diversity",
  "z_geo_spread",
  "z_success_rate",
  "lagged_district_terrorism_intensity"
)

missing_variables <- setdiff(
  required_variables,
  names(data_raw)
)

if (length(missing_variables) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste(
      "The following required variables are missing:",
      paste(missing_variables, collapse = ", ")
    )
  )
}

model_data <- data_raw |>
  filter(
    OCI_eligible == 1,
    ideology_category %in% c(
      "Maoist",
      "Separatist/Ethnonationalist",
      "Islamist"
    )
  ) |>
  transmute(
    hard_target =
      as.numeric(`Target Category`),

    organization =
      factor(gname),

    organization_year =
      interaction(
        gname,
        iyear,
        drop = TRUE
      ),

    year =
      factor(iyear),

    ideology = factor(
      ideology_category,
      levels = c(
        "Maoist",
        "Separatist/Ethnonationalist",
        "Islamist"
      )
    ),

    conflict_region = factor(
      conflict_region,
      levels = c(
        "Rest of India",
        "Kashmir",
        "Maoist-affected belt",
        "Northeast"
      )
    ),

    prior_attacks =
      as.numeric(z_prior_attacks),

    tactical_diversity =
      as.numeric(z_tactical_diversity),

    geographic_spread =
      as.numeric(z_geo_spread),

    success_rate =
      as.numeric(z_success_rate),

    ln_lagged_district_intensity =
      log1p(
        as.numeric(
          lagged_district_terrorism_intensity
        )
      )
  ) |>
  filter(
    if_all(
      everything(),
      ~ !is.na(.x)
    )
  )

if (!all(
  sort(unique(model_data$hard_target)) %in% c(0, 1)
)) {
  stop(
    "Target Category must be coded as 0 or 1."
  )
}

sample_summary <- data.frame(
  Statistic = c(
    "Incident-level observations",
    "Organizations",
    "Organization-years",
    "Hard-target observations",
    "Soft-target observations"
  ),

  Value = c(
    nrow(model_data),

    n_distinct(
      model_data$organization
    ),

    n_distinct(
      model_data$organization_year
    ),

    sum(
      model_data$hard_target == 1
    ),

    sum(
      model_data$hard_target == 0
    )
  )
)

kable(
  sample_summary,
  caption = paste(

## 3. Verify reference categories


#| label: verify-references

cat(
  "Reference ideology:",

cat(

## 4. Construct the four alternative indices


#| label: construct-loo-indices

model_data <- model_data |>
  mutate(
    # Excludes prior attack frequency
    OCI_without_prior_attacks =
      rowMeans(
        cbind(
          tactical_diversity,
          geographic_spread,
          success_rate
        )
      ),

    # Excludes tactical diversity
    OCI_without_tactical_diversity =
      rowMeans(
        cbind(
          prior_attacks,
          geographic_spread,
          success_rate
        )
      ),

    # Excludes geographic spread
    OCI_without_geographic_spread =
      rowMeans(
        cbind(
          prior_attacks,
          tactical_diversity,
          success_rate
        )
      ),

    # Excludes prior success rate
    OCI_without_success_rate =
      rowMeans(
        cbind(
          prior_attacks,
          tactical_diversity,
          geographic_spread
        )
      )
  )

loo_variable_names <- c(
  "OCI_without_prior_attacks",
  "OCI_without_tactical_diversity",
  "OCI_without_geographic_spread",
  "OCI_without_success_rate"
)

loo_model_labels <- c(
  "Excluding prior attacks",
  "Excluding tactical diversity",
  "Excluding geographic spread",
  "Excluding success rate"
)


## 5. Verify the construction of each index


#| label: verify-loo-indices

construction_check <- data.frame(
  Alternative_Index = loo_model_labels,

  Mean = sapply(
    model_data[loo_variable_names],
    mean
  ),

  SD = sapply(
    model_data[loo_variable_names],
    sd
  ),

  Minimum = sapply(
    model_data[loo_variable_names],
    min
  ),

  Maximum = sapply(
    model_data[loo_variable_names],
    max
  )
)

kable(
  construction_check,
  digits = 3,
  caption = paste(
    "Descriptive Statistics for",
    "Leave-One-Component-Out OCI Measures"
  )
)


## 6. Function for estimating Model 2

#| label: estimation-function

estimate_loo_model <- function(
  data,
  index_variable,
  model_label
) {

  analysis_data <- data |>
    mutate(
      loo_oci = .data[[index_variable]]
    )

  cat(
    "\nEstimating:",
    model_label,
    "\n"
  )

  starting_time <- Sys.time()

  fitted_model <- glmer(
    hard_target ~
      ideology * loo_oci +
      conflict_region +
      ln_lagged_district_intensity +
      year +
      (1 | organization),

    data = analysis_data,

    family = binomial(
      link = "logit"
    ),

    # Faster approximation for the initial run
    nAGQ = 0,

    control = glmerControl(
      optimizer = "bobyqa",

      optCtrl = list(
        maxfun = 100000
      ),

      calc.derivs = FALSE
    )
  )

  ending_time <- Sys.time()

  cat(
    "Completed:",
    model_label,
    "\n"
  )

  cat(
    "Estimation time:",
    round(
      as.numeric(
        difftime(
          ending_time,
          starting_time,
          units = "mins"
        )
      ),
      2
    ),
    "minutes\n"
  )

  return(fitted_model)
}

## 7. Estimate the four leave-one-component-out models

#| label: estimate-loo-models

output_directory <-
  "robustness_1C_outputs"

if (!dir.exists(output_directory)) {
  dir.create(output_directory)
}

loo_models <- list()

for (i in seq_along(loo_variable_names)) {

  current_label <-
    loo_model_labels[i]

  current_variable <-
    loo_variable_names[i]

  safe_file_name <- paste0(
    "model_",
    gsub(
      pattern = "[^A-Za-z0-9]+",
      replacement = "_",
      x = tolower(current_label)
    ),
    ".rds"
  )

  current_model_file <- file.path(
    output_directory,
    safe_file_name
  )

  if (file.exists(current_model_file)) {

    cat(
      "\nLoading saved model:",
      current_label,
      "\n"
    )

    loo_models[[current_label]] <-
      readRDS(current_model_file)

  } else {

    loo_models[[current_label]] <-
      estimate_loo_model(
        data = model_data,
        index_variable = current_variable,
        model_label = current_label
      )

    saveRDS(
      loo_models[[current_label]],
      current_model_file
    )

    cat(
      "Saved completed model to:",
      current_model_file,
      "\n"
    )
  }
}

cat(
  "\nAll four leave-one-component-out models are available.\n"
)

## 8. Extract the OCI and interaction coefficients

#| label: coefficient-results

extract_key_coefficients <- function(
  fitted_model,
  model_label
) {

  tidy(
    fitted_model,
    effects = "fixed",
    conf.int = TRUE,
    conf.method = "Wald"
  ) |>
    filter(
      term %in% c(
        "loo_oci",
        "ideologySeparatist/Ethnonationalist:loo_oci",
        "ideologyIslamist:loo_oci"
      )
    ) |>
    mutate(
      Model = model_label,

      Predictor = recode(
        term,

        "loo_oci" =
          "OCI slope: Maoist",

        "ideologySeparatist/Ethnonationalist:loo_oci" =
          "Separatist × OCI",

        "ideologyIslamist:loo_oci" =
          "Islamist × OCI"
      ),

      Odds_Ratio =
        exp(estimate),

      OR_CI_Lower =
        exp(conf.low),

      OR_CI_Upper =
        exp(conf.high)
    ) |>
    select(
      Model,
      Predictor,
      Coefficient = estimate,
      `Standard Error` = std.error,
      `95% CI Lower` = conf.low,
      `95% CI Upper` = conf.high,
      `Odds Ratio` = Odds_Ratio,
      `OR 95% CI Lower` = OR_CI_Lower,
      `OR 95% CI Upper` = OR_CI_Upper,
      `p-value` = p.value
    )
}

coefficient_results <- bind_rows(
  lapply(
    names(loo_models),
    function(model_name) {
      extract_key_coefficients(
        loo_models[[model_name]],
        model_name
      )
    }
  )
)

kable(
  coefficient_results,
  digits = 3,
  caption = paste(
    "Leave-One-Component-Out OCI",
    "Coefficients and Interactions"
  )
)


## 9. Calculate ideology-specific OCI slopes

#| label: ideology-specific-slopes

extract_slopes <- function(
  fitted_model,
  model_label
) {

  trend_results <- emtrends(
    fitted_model,
    specs = ~ ideology,
    var = "loo_oci"
  )

  trend_table <- as.data.frame(
    summary(
      trend_results,
      infer = c(TRUE, TRUE),
      level = 0.95
    )
  )

  # Identify the confidence-interval column names
  lower_column <- intersect(
    c("asymp.LCL", "lower.CL"),
    names(trend_table)
  )[1]

  upper_column <- intersect(
    c("asymp.UCL", "upper.CL"),
    names(trend_table)
  )[1]

  if (
    is.na(lower_column) ||
    is.na(upper_column)
  ) {
    stop(
      paste(
        "Confidence-interval columns could not",
        "be identified in the emtrends output."
      )
    )
  }

  trend_table |>
    mutate(
      Model = model_label,

      CI_Lower =
        .data[[lower_column]],

      CI_Upper =
        .data[[upper_column]]
    ) |>
    transmute(
      Model,

      Ideology =
        ideology,

      `OCI Slope` =
        loo_oci.trend,

      `Standard Error` =
        SE,

      `95% CI Lower` =
        CI_Lower,

      `95% CI Upper` =
        CI_Upper,

      `p-value` =
        p.value
    )
}

slope_results <- bind_rows(
  lapply(
    names(loo_models),
    function(model_name) {

      extract_slopes(
        fitted_model =
          loo_models[[model_name]],

        model_label =
          model_name
      )
    }
  )
)

kable(
  slope_results,
  digits = 3,
  caption = paste(
    "Ideology-Specific OCI Slopes Across",
    "Leave-One-Component-Out Models"
  )
)

## 10. Pairwise comparisons of ideology-specific slopes

#| label: pairwise-slope-comparisons

extract_slope_comparisons <- function(
  fitted_model,
  model_label
) {

  trend_results <- emtrends(
    fitted_model,
    specs = ~ ideology,
    var = "loo_oci"
  )

  comparison_results <- pairs(
    trend_results,
    adjust = "tukey"
  )

  comparison_table <- as.data.frame(
    summary(
      comparison_results,
      infer = c(TRUE, TRUE),
      level = 0.95,
      adjust = "tukey"
    )
  )

  # Identify the confidence-interval column names
  lower_column <- intersect(
    c("asymp.LCL", "lower.CL"),
    names(comparison_table)
  )[1]

  upper_column <- intersect(
    c("asymp.UCL", "upper.CL"),
    names(comparison_table)
  )[1]

  if (
    is.na(lower_column) ||
    is.na(upper_column)
  ) {
    stop(
      paste(
        "Confidence-interval columns could not",
        "be identified in the pairwise output."
      )
    )
  }

  comparison_table |>
    mutate(
      Model = model_label,

      CI_Lower =
        .data[[lower_column]],

      CI_Upper =
        .data[[upper_column]]
    ) |>
    transmute(
      Model,

      Comparison =
        contrast,

      `Difference in Slopes` =
        estimate,

      `Standard Error` =
        SE,

      `95% CI Lower` =
        CI_Lower,

      `95% CI Upper` =
        CI_Upper,

      `Adjusted p-value` =
        p.value
    )
}

pairwise_results <- bind_rows(
  lapply(
    names(loo_models),
    function(model_name) {

      extract_slope_comparisons(
        fitted_model =
          loo_models[[model_name]],

        model_label =
          model_name
      )
    }
  )
)

kable(
  pairwise_results,
  digits = 3,
  caption = paste(
    "Pairwise Comparisons of",
    "Ideology-Specific OCI Slopes"
  )
)


## 11. Extract model diagnostics


#| label: diagnostics-function

extract_model_diagnostics <- function(
  fitted_model,
  model_label
) {

  random_variance <- as.data.frame(
    VarCorr(fitted_model)
  )$vcov[1]

  random_sd <-
    sqrt(random_variance)

  icc <- random_variance /
    (
      random_variance +
      (pi^2 / 3)
    )

  optimizer_code <-
    fitted_model@optinfo$conv$opt

  convergence_messages <-
    fitted_model@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages

  data.frame(
    Model = model_label,

    Observations =
      nobs(fitted_model),

    Organizations =
      length(
        unique(
          fitted_model@frame$organization
        )
      ),

    Log_Likelihood =
      as.numeric(
        logLik(fitted_model)
      ),

    AIC =
      AIC(fitted_model),

    BIC =
      BIC(fitted_model),

    Random_Intercept_Variance =
      random_variance,

    Random_Intercept_SD =
      random_sd,

    ICC =
      icc,

    Singular =
      isSingular(
        fitted_model,
        tol = 0.0001
      ),

    Optimizer_Code =
      paste(
        optimizer_code,
        collapse = ", "
      ),

    Convergence_Warnings =
      ifelse(
        is.null(convergence_messages),
        "None",
        paste(
          convergence_messages,
          collapse = "; "
        )
      )
  )
}

diagnostic_results <- bind_rows(
  lapply(
    names(loo_models),
    function(model_name) {
      extract_model_diagnostics(
        loo_models[[model_name]],
        model_name
      )
    }
  )
)

kable(
  diagnostic_results,
  digits = 3,
  caption = paste(
    "Model-Fit and Estimation Diagnostics"
  )
)
